In such cases, using drugs might seem like the only way to get everything done. But even then, there are healthier alternatives, like seeking help from advisors, using time management techniques, or taking care of their health to maintain productivity without resorting to drugs. I also wonder about the societal perspective. In some cultures, using stimulants or other drugs to stay productive is more common, especially in high-pressure environments like academia or business. In summary, while the immediate goal of finishing the thesis might be achieved, the negative consequences on health, ethics, and long-term well-being make this action problematic.
